channel.note: Widths and the fallback energy slope are explicit reduced-model assumptions, not surveyed channel dimensions. Manning n=0.04 is reported for the Lower Liffey in-bank domain in OPW Hydraulics Report section 4.7.3.7.

hydrograph.note: A normalised gamma-shaped design hydrograph represents the rising and receding limb; Qmed is used as the pre-event reference flow. It is not a reconstructed historical flood.

upstream_node.source: OPW Eastern CFRAM Hydrology Report, Appendix D, Model 2C

downstream_flow_node.source: OPW Eastern CFRAM Hydrology Report, Appendix D, Model 2C

coastal_node.source: OPW Eastern CFRAM Hydraulics Report, Table 4.7.2; published extreme coastal levels include tide, surge and seiching allowances

tide.source: Marine Institute IMI_TidePrediction_HighLow, high/low predictions in OD Malin
